Buying a new build? First-time buyers may get the GST back. The First-Time Home Buyers' GST/HST Rebate can be worth up to $50,000: a full rebate on homes up to $1 million, a reduced rebate between $1 million and $1.5 million, and none at $1.5 million or more. At least one buyer must be a first-time buyer who will live in the home, and the rebate can be claimed once in a lifetime. Ontario also has a first-time buyer rebate on the provincial part of the HST. Swipe through the 7 slides and save this for later.

First home? Your insured mortgage may stretch to 30 years. Since December 15, 2024, first-time buyers and buyers of new builds can choose a 30-year amortization on an insured mortgage, and the price cap for insured mortgages rose from $1 million to $1.5 million. A longer amortization lowers your payments but means more interest over time, and your lender decides what you qualify for.

Closing day is coming. A final-week checklist many buyers use: 1) arrange home insurance so it is in place for closing day, 2) set up utilities and address changes, 3) confirm your movers, 4) do your final walkthrough, 5) ask your lawyer what funds are due and when. Your agreement and your lawyer set the exact steps and timelines.
